body.message:
Great news, we have options in Downtown Dubai that could work well for you.

For a 1BR, we have a unit in Act One Tower 1 at AED 7,999/month, fully furnished and all-inclusive (water, electricity, internet). Here's the listing with full photos: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-downtown-dubai-opera-district-act-towers-act-two-2PriO0ZIshU.html

For a 2BR, we have a unit in Grande Downtown at AED 15,000/month, also fully furnished and all-inclusive. Photos here: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-downtown-dubai-opera-district-grande-14592976.html

Both buildings are in the heart of Downtown, close to each other. They are high quality, modern finishes, and ready to move in from April 10.
